failure paths that must not change state.

Boundary for this slice: RWB-S2-E3013-APP owns the encumbrance and title check and its check answer, and RWB-P3-E3013-APP owns the case state move, the task and the decision record. The path, verb and fields of the check-answer operation are to be fixed by RWB-S2-E3013-CON. The task due date takes its timer from that answer; until a parameter is named, the platform one-hop default of 2 s applies. The requirement ID for this slice and the field IDs of check_ref, check_outcome_code and decision_record_id are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0736).

edits.old: And a contract version that differs from the registry fails the run before any assertion
edits.new:
And a contract version that differs from the registry fails the run before any assertion

  Scenario: AC4 Each rule of section 8 holds in the run, and the harness writes no treatment row (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the cases of AC1 to AC3 are seeded and the rules of section 8 are in force
    When the owning services apply the checks before negotiation
    Then the check runs before negotiation starts and a deed in lieu is not negotiated on an asset that cannot transfer
    And the case, the decision record and the task each match the rule and version recorded for their move
    And the harness has written no treatment row
    And the run is green with one trace and one hop per call

  Scenario: AC5 A redelivered consumed event changes nothing and writes no second record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed event has been applied once to a case
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the case, the treatment and the task are unchanged
    And exactly one decision record exists for that move

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed call that fails or does not answer changes nothing and writes no decision record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call to the owning service fails or does not answer
    When the owning service is asked to apply R-DIL-01 or R-SET-22
    Then nothing changes on the case, the treatment or the task
    And no decision record is written
    And the run fails and reports the call
